scope: CPU support/operation opportunity and exact diagnostic arithmetic; no RTL cycles, frozen FP32 claim, PPA or AEE

c1.scope_note: 192 predetermined tiles, same ep34 ledger. Joint selection only between maximum-popcount legal parents. Dictionary choices are an offline greedy opportunity screen; all search counts are reported, not hidden by a latency claim.
comparisons: fixed parents with the joint-selected dictionary
c1.accounting: Report binary vector adds, original weight reads, parent result reads and live writes, dictionary reads/writes, destination commits and live state separately. No sum of unlike costs reported as cycles.
c1.numeric_validation: All selected support tiles use signed diagnostic W and distinct nonunit rational theta values, with a shared denominator. This is not an ep34 weight/quantization evaluation.

c2.question: Is the number R of nonempty complete-T source signatures below T at a position, allowing V_sigma to replace T stored Y values across dynamic BN?
metrics: T*R vs T*T PSN coefficient terms
source terms versus signature construction plus complete Y restoration
c2.guard: Same-sample temporal steps only; not adjacent-frame reuse. No checkpoint forward, no new AEE, no hidden omission of BN cross terms. R<T is necessary at equal width but not sufficient after metadata.
